title: Prakrama 4, Sarga 2. Beholding Sri Mathura-mandala
html:
By way of Prayaga, Agra, Renuka, Rajagrama and Gokula the Lord comes to Mathura; there the brahmana Krishnadasa meets Him, and the Lord bids him reveal to Him the holy places of Mathura-mandala; the night passes in talk of the pastimes of Vraja

Verse 1

ततः प्रयागमासाद्य दृष्ट्वा श्रीमाधवं प्रभुः।
प्रेमानन्दसुधापूर्णो ननर्त स्वजनैः सह॥१॥

tataḥ prayāgamāsādya dṛṣṭvā śrīmādhavaṁ prabhuḥ|
premānandasudhāpūrṇo nanarta svajanaiḥ saha||1||

tatah — then; prayagam — Prayaga; asadya — reaching; drishtva — seeing; shri-madhavam — Sri Madhava; prabhuh — the Lord; prema-ananda-sudha-purnah — filled with the nectar of the bliss of love; nanarta — danced; sva-janaih saha — with His people.

1Then the Lord came to Prayaga and, seeing Sri Madhava1, He was filled with the nectar of the bliss of love and danced with His companions.

Verse 2

श्रीलाक्षयवटं दृष्ट्वा त्रिवेणीस्नानमाचरन्।
यमुनायां च संमज्य नृत्यन् पारीन्द्रलीलया॥२॥

śrīlākṣayavaṭaṁ dṛṣṭvā triveṇīsnānamācaran|
yamunāyāṁ ca saṁmajya nṛtyan pārīndralīlayā||2||

shrila-akshaya-vatam — the glorious Akshaya-vata; drishtva — seeing; triveni-snanam — bathing at the Triveni; acharan — performing; yamunayam — in the Yamuna; cha — and; sammajya — plunging; nrityan — dancing; parindra-lilaya — with the bearing of a lion.

2He saw the glorious Akshaya-vata2, bathed at the Triveni3, plunged into the Yamuna and danced with the bearing of a lion.

Verse 3

हुङ्कारगम्भीरारावैः प्रेमाश्रुपुलकैर्वृतः।
व्रजन् क्रमात्तामुत्तीर्य वनं चाग्रं ददर्श ह॥३॥

huṅkāragambhīrārāvaiḥ premāśrupulakairvṛtaḥ|
vrajan kramāttāmuttīrya vanaṁ cāgraṁ dadarśa ha||3||

hunkara-gambhira-aravaih — with deep rumbling cries of "hum"; prema-ashru-pulakaih — with tears of love and thrills; vritah — enveloped; vrajan — going on; kramat — by stages; tam — her (the Yamuna); uttirya — crossing; vanam — the forest; cha — and; agram — of Agra; dadarsha — saw; ha — indeed.

3With deep rumbling cries, wrapped in tears of love and thrills of rapture, He went on and on, and having crossed the Yamuna He saw the forest of Agra4.

Verse 4

तत्रैव रेणुका नाम ग्रामो यत्र युधां पतिः।
जामदग्निर्महात्मा च पुण्यक्षेत्रे ययौ ततः॥४॥

tatraiva reṇukā nāma grāmo yatra yudhāṁ patiḥ|
jāmadagnirmahātmā ca puṇyakṣetre yayau tataḥ||4||

tatra eva — right there; renuka — Renuka; nama — by name; gramah — a village; yatra — where; yudham — of warriors; patih — the lord; jamadagnih — the son of Jamadagni; maha-atma — great-souled; cha — and; punya-kshetre — to the holy place; yayau — went; tatah — then.

4There lies a village named Renuka, the home of the great-souled son of Jamadagni, the lord of warriors5; to that holy place He then went.

Verse 5

तत्रैव यमुनां दृष्ट्वा वृन्दारण्योन्मुखीं सदा।
राजग्रामं ततो गत्वा गोकुलं प्रेक्ष्य विह्वलः॥५॥

tatraiva yamunāṁ dṛṣṭvā vṛndāraṇyonmukhīṁ sadā|
rājagrāmaṁ tato gatvā gokulaṁ prekṣya vihvalaḥ||5||

tatra eva — right there; yamunam — the Yamuna; drishtva — seeing; vrinda-aranya-unmukhim — turned toward the forest of Vrinda; sada — ever; raja-gramam — to Rajagrama; tatah — then; gatva — going; gokulam — Gokula; prekshya — beholding; vihvalah — overwhelmed.

5There He saw the Yamuna, ever turned toward the forest of Vrinda; then He came to Rajagrama6 and, beholding Gokula, was overwhelmed.

Verse 6

महारण्यं च संपश्यन् मथुरां च ददर्श ह।
राजधानीं महैश्वर्ययुक्तां परमशोभनाम्॥६॥

mahāraṇyaṁ ca saṁpaśyan mathurāṁ ca dadarśa ha|
rājadhānīṁ mahaiśvaryayuktāṁ paramaśobhanām||6||

maha-aranyam — the Great Forest (Mahavana); cha — and; sampashyan — beholding; mathuram — Mathura; cha — and; dadarsha — saw; ha — indeed; rajadhanim — the royal capital; maha-aishvarya-yuktam — endowed with great majesty; parama-shobhanam — supremely beautiful.

6Beholding Maharanya7, He saw Mathura too — the royal capital, endowed with great majesty and supremely beautiful,

Verse 7

श्रीवैकुण्ठादिधाम्नां हि परमाराधनं भुवि।
श्रीकृष्णप्रकटं चापि प्रेमभक्तिप्रदायिनीम्॥७॥

śrīvaikuṇṭhādidhāmnāṁ hi paramārādhanaṁ bhuvi|
śrīkṛṣṇaprakaṭaṁ cāpi premabhaktipradāyinīm||7||

shri-vaikuntha-adi-dhamnam — of Sri Vaikuntha and the other abodes; hi — indeed; parama-aradhanam — the supreme object of worship; bhuvi — on earth; shri-krishna-prakatam — the place where Sri Krishna appeared; cha api — and also; prema-bhakti-pradayinim — bestowing loving devotion.

7the supreme object of worship on earth even for Sri Vaikuntha and the other abodes, the place where Sri Krishna appeared, the bestower of loving devotion.

Verse 8

दृष्ट्वा गौरहरिः प्रेमविकारसर्वसंयुतः।
हसन् नृत्यन् रुदन् भूमौ विलुठन् पुलकाचितः॥८॥

dṛṣṭvā gaurahariḥ premavikārasarvasaṁyutaḥ|
hasan nṛtyan rudan bhūmau viluṭhan pulakācitaḥ||8||

drishtva — seeing; gaura-harih — Gaurahari; prema-vikara-sarva-samyutah — possessed by all the transformations of love; hasan — laughing; nrityan — dancing; rudan — weeping; bhumau — on the ground; viluthan — rolling; pulaka-achitah — covered with thrills.

8At the sight of it Gaurahari, possessed by every transformation of love, laughed, danced, wept and rolled on the ground, His whole body thrilling.

Verse 9

तत्रैव कश्चिद्द्विजवर्यसत्तमः
पश्यन् हरिं प्रेमविभिन्नधैर्यः।
रोमाञ्चितैर्युक्तसगद्गदं कृती
पपात पादौ जगदीश्वरस्य॥९॥

tatraiva kaściddvijavaryasattamaḥ
paśyan hariṁ premavibhinnadhairyaḥ|
romāñcitairyuktasagadgadaṁ kṛtī
papāta pādau jagadīśvarasya||9||

tatra eva — right there; kashchit — a certain; dvija-varya-sattamah — best of excellent brahmanas; pashyan — seeing; harim — Hari; prema-vibhinna-dhairyah — his composure shattered by love; romanchitaih — with bristling hair; yukta-sa-gadgadam — seized, with a faltering voice; kriti — the virtuous one; papata — fell; padau — at the feet; jagat-ishvarasya — of the Lord of the world.

9There a certain brahmana, best of the best, seeing Hari, lost all composure in love; his hair bristled, his voice faltered, and that virtuous man fell at the feet of the Lord of the world.

Verse 10

कस्त्वं भवान् प्रेमविभिन्नधैर्यो
दृष्टोऽसि मे भाग्यवशादिति स्वयम्।
प्रीतः पुनः प्राह स एव च प्रभुं
दासोऽस्म्यहं ते भगवन् दयानिधे॥१०॥

kastvaṁ bhavān premavibhinnadhairyo
dṛṣṭo'si me bhāgyavaśāditi svayam|
prītaḥ punaḥ prāha sa eva ca prabhuṁ
dāso'smyahaṁ te bhagavan dayānidhe||10||

kah — who; tvam — you; bhavan — sir; prema-vibhinna-dhairyah — your composure shattered by love; drishtah asi — you have been seen; me — by Me; bhagya-vashat — by good fortune; iti — thus (He said); svayam — Himself; pritah — pleased; punah — in reply; praha — said; sah — he; eva — indeed; cha — and; prabhum — to the Lord; dasah — servant; asmi — am; aham — I; te — Your; bhagavan — O Lord; daya-nidhe — O treasury of mercy.

10"Who are you, good sir, whose composure love has shattered? By good fortune I have seen you," said the Lord Himself. And he, delighted, answered the Lord: "I am Your servant, O Lord, treasury of mercy.

Verse 11

नाम्ना हि मात्रं यदि कृष्णदास-
स्तथापि त्वद्दर्शनभाग्यवानहम्।
कृपानिधे वैष्णवपादरेणुभिः
पुनीहि मां नन्दकिशोर गौर॥११॥

nāmnā hi mātraṁ yadi kṛṣṇadāsa-
stathāpi tvaddarśanabhāgyavānaham|
kṛpānidhe vaiṣṇavapādareṇubhiḥ
punīhi māṁ nandakiśora gaura||11||

namna — by name; hi — indeed; matram — only; yadi — though; krishna-dasah — Krishnadasa ("servant of Krishna"); tatha api — yet; tvat-darshana-bhagyavan — blessed with the fortune of seeing You; aham — I; kripa-nidhe — O treasury of mercy; vaishnava-pada-renubhih — with the dust of the Vaishnavas' feet; punihi — purify; mam — me; nanda-kishora — O youthful son of Nanda; gaura — O Gaura.

11Though I am Krishnadasa8 in name only, yet I have had the good fortune of seeing You. O treasury of mercy, purify me with the dust of the Vaishnavas' feet, O Gaura, youthful son of Nanda!"

Verse 12

श्रुत्वा प्रभुर्हर्षरसाब्धिमग्नः
प्राह त्वमेव खलु कृष्णदासः।
श्रीकृष्णधाम्नो हि रहस्यलीलां
जानासि सर्वां कथयस्व सत्तम॥१२॥

śrutvā prabhurharṣarasābdhimagnaḥ
prāha tvameva khalu kṛṣṇadāsaḥ|
śrīkṛṣṇadhāmno hi rahasyalīlāṁ
jānāsi sarvāṁ kathayasva sattama||12||

shrutva — hearing; prabhuh — the Lord; harsha-rasa-abdhi-magnah — immersed in an ocean of the rasa of joy; praha — said; tvam — you; eva — indeed; khalu — truly; krishna-dasah — a servant of Krishna; shri-krishna-dhamnah — of Sri Krishna's abode; hi — for; rahasya-lilam — the secret pastimes; janasi — you know; sarvam — all; kathayasva — tell; sattama — O best of men.

12Hearing this, the Lord was immersed in an ocean of the rasa of joy and said, "It is you who are truly a servant of Krishna. For you know all the secret pastimes of Sri Krishna's abode — tell them, O best of men!"

Verse 13

स त्वेनमाह शृणु केशव प्रभो
यदि स्वयं भक्तजनाभिमानी।
तथापि पादौ विनिधाय मे हृदि
प्रकाशय त्वं मधुमण्डलं निजम्॥१३॥

sa tvenamāha śṛṇu keśava prabho
yadi svayaṁ bhaktajanābhimānī|
tathāpi pādau vinidhāya me hṛdi
prakāśaya tvaṁ madhumaṇḍalaṁ nijam||13||

sah — he; tu — then; enam — to Him; aha — said; shrinu — listen; keshava — O Keshava; prabho — O Lord; yadi — though; svayam — Yourself; bhakta-jana-abhimani — regarding Yourself as a devotee; tatha api — yet; padau — Your feet; vinidhaya — placing; me — my; hridi — in the heart; prakashaya — reveal; tvam — You; madhu-mandalam — the land of Madhu; nijam — Your own.

13And he said to Him, "Listen, O Keshava, O Lord! Though You Yourself take the part of a devotee, yet place Your feet in my heart and reveal Your own Madhu-mandala9."

Verse 14

पीत्वा च तस्य वचनामृतं हरि-
र्जगाद जीमूतगभीरया गिरा।
मदाज्ञया ते च श्रीकृष्णलीलाः
स्फुरन्तु धामानि च सर्वतः सुखम्॥१४॥

pītvā ca tasya vacanāmṛtaṁ hari-
rjagāda jīmūtagabhīrayā girā|
madājñayā te ca śrīkṛṣṇalīlāḥ
sphurantu dhāmāni ca sarvataḥ sukham||14||

pitva — drinking; cha — and; tasya — his; vachana-amritam — nectar of words; harih — Hari; jagada — spoke; jimuta-gabhiraya — deep as a thundercloud; gira — in a voice; mat-ajnaya — by My command; te — to you; cha — and; shri-krishna-lilah — the pastimes of Sri Krishna; sphurantu — may they shine forth; dhamani — the holy places; cha — and; sarvatah — everywhere; sukham — with ease.

14Drinking the nectar of his words, Hari spoke in a voice as deep as a thundercloud: "By My command may the pastimes of Sri Krishna and the holy places shine forth to you with ease on every side."

Verse 15

तदा स विप्रश्चरणाब्जसन्निधौ
पपात हर्षेण प्रभो दयानिधे।
धृत्वा पदौ ते मम मस्तकोपरि
संदर्शयिष्ये भवते च सर्वम्॥१५॥

tadā sa vipraścaraṇābjasannidhau
papāta harṣeṇa prabho dayānidhe|
dhṛtvā padau te mama mastakopari
saṁdarśayiṣye bhavate ca sarvam||15||

tada — then; sah — that; viprah — brahmana; charana-abja-sannidhau — near His lotus feet; papata — fell; harshena — with joy; prabho — O Lord; daya-nidhe — O treasury of mercy; dhritva — placing; padau — feet; te — Your; mama — my; mastaka-upari — on the head; sandarshayishye — I shall show; bhavate — to You; cha — and; sarvam — everything.

15Then the brahmana fell for joy at His lotus feet: "O Lord, treasury of mercy! When You have placed Your feet on my head, I shall show You everything."

Verse 16

इति ब्रुवन् गौररसेन मत्तो
नृत्यन् रुदन् प्रेमविभिन्नधैर्यः।
श्रीरासलीलाम्बुविलासवैभव-
मगायत गोपीपतिर्मुहुर्मुहुः॥१६॥

iti bruvan gaurarasena matto
nṛtyan rudan premavibhinnadhairyaḥ|
śrīrāsalīlāmbuvilāsavaibhava-
magāyata gopīpatirmuhurmuhuḥ||16||

iti — thus; bruvan — speaking; gaura-rasena — with the rasa of Gaura; mattah — intoxicated; nrityan — dancing; rudan — weeping; prema-vibhinna-dhairyah — his composure shattered by love; shri-rasa-lila-ambu-vilasa-vaibhavam — the splendour of the water-sports of the sacred rasa dance; agayata — sang; gopi-patih — the Lord of the gopis; muhuh muhuh — again and again.

16So he spoke, intoxicated with the rasa of Gaura, dancing and weeping, his composure shattered by love; and the Lord of the gopis sang again and again of the splendour of the water-sports after the sacred rasa dance10.

Verse 17

एवं जगन्मोहनलीलया हरिः
सुखं रजन्यां व्रजकेलिवार्तया।
श्रीराधिकाकृष्णविलासलास्यं
जगौ परं भक्तिरसेन पूर्णः॥१७॥

evaṁ jaganmohanalīlayā hariḥ
sukhaṁ rajanyāṁ vrajakelivārtayā|
śrīrādhikākṛṣṇavilāsalāsyaṁ
jagau paraṁ bhaktirasena pūrṇaḥ||17||

evam — thus; jagat-mohana-lilaya — with world-enchanting play; harih — Hari; sukham — happily; rajanyam — at night; vraja-keli-vartaya — with talk of the sports of Vraja; shri-radhika-krishna-vilasa-lasyam — the graceful dance of the loving pastimes of Sri Radhika and Krishna; jagau — sang; param — wholly; bhakti-rasena — with the rasa of bhakti; purnah — filled.

17Thus that night Hari, in His world-enchanting play, talked happily of the sports of Vraja and, wholly filled with the rasa of bhakti, sang of the graceful dance of the loving pastimes of Sri Radhika and Krishna.

Thus ends the second sarga, "Beholding Sri Mathura-mandala" (Shri-mathura-mandala-darshana), of the fourth prakrama of the poem "Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita."

✦

Notes

  1. Sri Madhava: Veni-Madhava, the Deity of Vishnu at Prayaga (Allahabad).
  2. Akshaya-vata: "the undying banyan," the sacred tree at Prayaga.
  3. The Triveni: the confluence of three rivers (the Ganga, the Yamuna and the hidden Sarasvati) at Prayaga.
  4. Both the reading and the sense of this place are conjectural; it may also mean "and saw a forest ahead."
  5. The son of Jamadagni is Parashurama; Renuka, Parashurama's mother, gave her name to the village (now Runakta near Agra).
  6. Rajagrama: a village on the way to Gokula; its exact location is uncertain.
  7. Maharanya ("the Great Forest"): Mahavana, where Gokula lies.
  8. Krishnadasa: "servant of Krishna."
  9. Madhu-mandala: the land of Madhu, that is, Mathura-mandala.
  10. The water-sports: Krishna's play with the gopis in the Yamuna after the rasa dance (Bhagavata Purana 10.33).
